note: Sweep: federal student council plans its own Berlin demonstration (ZDFheute, Oct 29)

event.label: reported
event.text: Germany's federal student council (Bundesschülerkonferenz) distanced itself from the "Gen Z regelt" protests, citing unclear organisational structures, and announced its own demonstration in Berlin for November 20, ZDFheute reports. The council said it is organising it with a civil-society alliance, and that the teachers' union GEW, the federal parents' council and Fridays for Future had reportedly agreed to take part.
